name: Add JSDoc documentation to exported functions
description: Add standardized JSDoc comments to all 3 exported functions in src/string-utils.ts describing parameters and return values.

inputs.task_prompt: Add JSDoc comments (/** ... */) to all 3 exported functions (capitalize, slugify, truncate) in src/string-utils.ts. Each JSDoc must describe what the function does, include @param tags for all arguments, and a @returns tag. Do not change any function implementations.

acceptance_criteria: All 3 exported functions have JSDoc comments starting with /**
@param tags are present for all parameters in all 3 functions
@returns tag is present on all 3 functions
Existing code and tests in test/string-utils.test.ts pass unmodified
constraints: Do not modify implementation logic or tests
